svg.title: I04 / ORION SENTINEL CORE engineering mission profile
svg.desc: I04, ORION SENTINEL CORE. Original project: EagleSat Team: On-board Computer Subsystem. Session I: Aerospace Technology. Scientific question: Does an FPGA-assisted redundant architecture recover from isolated faults without missing critical deadlines or corrupting the authoritative scientific record? Testable hypothesis: Selective hardware offload and independently monitored recovery will outperform blanket replication when voter faults, shared clocks, memory errors, and power cycling are included.. svg.text: No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Create a fault-aware on-board-computer reference architecture around the
original EagleSat FPGA/soft-core concept. Connect scientific data production
to scheduling, power states, memory integrity, and explicit recovery
behavior. The research question is not whether redundancy exists on a block
diagram; it is whether the spacecraft retains a bounded, observable
scientific service when individual faults and shared dependencies are
Does an FPGA-assisted redundant architecture recover from isolated faults
without missing critical deadlines or corrupting the authoritative
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
Selective hardware offload and independently monitored recovery will
outperform blanket replication when voter faults, shared clocks, memory
errors, and power cycling are included.
Fixed-priority response-time analysis requires bounded execution, blocking,
Triple modular redundancy gains are conditional on fault independence;
common-mode failures are explicitly added to the fault tree.
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
Logic simulation and software fault injection do not reproduce radiation
susceptibility, latch-up, thermal effects, or flight qualification. The
historical MicroBlaze concept is retained as context; device and toolchain
choices require an actual board inventory.
COUNTS OF RECORDS · NO COMPLETION SCORES
TRACEABILITY / IDs THAT STAY WITH THE WORK
Execution evidence is required before case closure.
References are pointers; archive acquisition is separate.
A question becomes a model. A model earns evidence.
NASA-inspired mission names are creative identifiers. This profile describes research design; it claims no NASA approval or flight qualification.
Original titles are preserved. Data pointers and citations do not establish that the original teams’ observations have been acquired.
